title: Tenant memory quarantine and KV salvage playbook for cross-env OOM/corruption
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Customers across Hosted, Dedicated and Private deployments observed intermittent GPU OOMs and progressive KV cache corruption under a corner-case workload: high-concurrency long-sequence multi-session requests with tenant-affinity scheduling. Root cause appears to be a race between the KV index compactor and the tenant handoff path that leaves stale KV handles (tombstones) in live arenas; under bursty allocation this leads to memory fragmentation and eventually per-GPU OOM. This ticket coordinates an urgent runtime patch (index-fence + eviction-heartbeat), a temporary per-tenant memory quarantine/soft-cap, and a controlled rollout with monitoring and rollback criteria. The work spans patch development, CI/perf regression testing, canary rollout across Hosted, Dedicated pool adjustments, and Private customer upgrade notes. Includes customer comms and postmortem follow-ups.
